tools.name: get_stock_signals
tools.description: Technical signals for up to 10 US, Hong Kong or China A-share stocks: latest close, 1-day and 5-day change, and 8 indicator dimensions (MACD, MA, RSI, KDJ, Bollinger, ADX, volume, money flow), each bullish / bearish / neutral with a 5-day trail and the latest values (e.g. RSI, KDJ K/D/J, MACD DIF/DE

tools.name: get_my_portfolio
tools.description: Your saved PickSkill portfolios (pickskill.ai/portfolios): holdings and weights, plus each holding's latest price change and its 8 indicator signals, with bullish/bearish counts per holding for a quick health check. Counts as one conversation against your PickSkill plan.

tools.name: get_earnings_highlights
tools.description: A company's latest earnings release (report date, actual vs. estimated EPS, surprise) plus its key financial ratios (valuation, margins, ROE, leverage, growth). Best for US-listed stocks. Counts as one conversation against your PickSkill plan.

tools.name: screen_stocks
tools.description: Screen PickSkill's US / Hong Kong / China A-share stock universe (the stocks with pickskill.ai/stocks pages) by technical conditions, ANDed: a dimension's reading held for N days (type 'signal'), an indicator value such as rsi.rsi < 35 or kdj.j (type 'value'), or a MACD / MA5-MA20 golden or death cr
